text:
marie: Hey team — drafting the Kitefish release notes for the docs site. Need a quick pass on: 1) feature highlights, 2) short SDK snippets for TS/Python, 3) known issues + workarounds, and 4) links to the perf benchmarks. Planning to publish Fri EOD. Can people add tiny commits to the PR? :pray:

alex: I pushed perf numbers into the draft PR — long-seq throughput up ~30% for most workloads. I put the charts under /docs/perf and linked them. Where should the short headline go? top of the release notes or under "What's new"?

sam: Top of the release notes please. I'll write a 2-line product blurb that doesn't use jargon.

nora: I can add the quickstart SDK snippets. @tim can you confirm the TS streaming example after the client change? I added a placeholder.

marie: Thanks. Also we need a small migration note about model pinning: some customers will want to pin model versions to avoid fallback changes. Keep it 1-2 sentences with a link to the rollout docs.

jen: Heads up from support — one known issue: when fallback routing kicks in between quantized variants, embedding vectors can differ slightly (cosine drift). Workaround: set model_version and disable auto-fallback for evaluation runs. I'll add a short note and link to the ticket.

alex: Can we add a "Known issues" box near the top? Customers skim releases and miss footnotes.

marie: Good idea. Short, bold box with 2 bullets: embeddings drift (jen's note) and SDK streaming retry edge case.

tim: TS snippet is fine — note we changed streaming interface: use .stream() not .on('data'). Here's the sample I tested locally:```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'kitefish-v1', input: 'Summarize the doc' });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```Add a one-line note about the retry behaviour when preempted.

nora: Python snippet too (quick):```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
for chunk in c.responses.stream(model='kitefish-v1', input='Summarize the doc'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```Small and mirror TS pattern.

marie: Perfect. @alex can you also add the link anchor to the perf chart (perf -> anchor perf/kitefish-2024-06) and @sam pls review the product blurb in the PR.

alex: Done (linked anchor). Also fixed a broken docs internal link in migration guide: docs/migrate/quantized -> docs/migrate/quantization (was 404).

sam: Copy LGTM with one tweak: mention "Dedicated customers can opt into the new batching" — I added that sentence.

jen: I've attached the support ticket links in the draft and added the workaround steps. Also added a contact line: support@redwood.ai if they hit the embeddings drift.

marie: Nice. Small editorial ask: can we keep each feature bullet to one sentence max? We're limited on the release notes landing page.

nora: I'll trim text and open a tiny PR with the SDK snippets + one-sentence bullets.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: build queued for branch release/kitefish — watch logs at https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4821 :robot_face:

marie: Thanks all — if no further objections I'll merge the PR at 4pm PT and cut the release notes live. If anyone wants a changelog entry in the repo CHANGELOG.md, add it to the PR before merge. :shipit:
